analyst_view.overall: Early view: Besiktas host Samsunspor six days after the Galatasaray derby. Vincenzo Italiano's side beat Genclerbirligi 3-0 in their last home game before the break, with Vlahovic scoring twice, and Samsunspor (17th) under Nenad Bjelica have conceded 26 goals, including five at Basaksehir. Besiktas are also in European competition, so rotation around this game is possible.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.0 goals and I lean slightly higher. Samsunspor's defence is the second-worst in the league, and Besiktas at home have been convincing, with Trossard setting up three goals against Genclerbirligi.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.8 corners, mostly Besiktas's. That fits how they play at home, holding the ball and pinning teams back, so I keep it.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.4 cards and I lean lower. Besiktas should control the game, and Samsunspor's one win under Bjelica came from defending deep and organised rather than fouling high up the pitch.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.0 shots, 18.7 for Besiktas. That is consistent with their home dominance (about 70% possession in the first half against Genclerbirligi), so I stay with it.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.8 shots on target. Vlahovic, with nine league goals, gets plenty of efforts on target, and Samsunspor will add a few, so I keep it near ten.
